channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: What’s the story behind the abandoned Cold War station in Finland, Minn.?
item.description: Now a ghost town, the remote spot on Lookout Mountain was once part of a secret defense network.

item.title: MSHSL adopts rules that prohibit coordinated chants from high school baseball dugouts
item.description: Bench decorum rules aim to shift behavior that distracts players.

item.title: Swapped, covered and removed: The license plate tactics ICE is using in Minnesota
item.description: The Department of Homeland Security defends secretive practices as safety measures.

item.title: Analysis: Rudy Gobert frustrated by Timberwolves’ defensive lapses in 119-115 loss to Pelicans
item.description: The four-time NBA Defensive Player of the Year pleaded for accountability, saying players need to be benched if they don’t give their all on defense.

item.title: Major cycling trade show Frostbike canceled due to concerns over ICE surge
item.description: Quality Bike Products has turned away hundreds of suppliers and retailers for a show planned later this month.

item.title: Jan. 6 rioter Jake Lang charged with damaging $6K ice sculpture at Minnesota Capitol
item.description: A veteran-led grassroots organization erected the sculpture spelling out “prosecute ICE.” Lang kicked out some of the letters to instead read “pro ICE.”

item.title: Pimento Jamaican Kitchen and owner sued for $1M in unpaid loans, rent
item.description: Most of the lawsuits involve the Pimento on the Lake location at Bde Maka Ska in Minneapolis. The owner, Derek “Tomme” Beevas, is known for his community outreach.

item.title: Hennepin County sheriff hasn’t decided how much to aid ICE, even if it helps end surge
item.description: Sheriff Dawanna Witt told reporters Friday she’s met with federal officials four times but is still unsure about how much to cooperate with immigration enforcement.

item.title: The latest: Inside Whipple, concern about measles spreading from Texas detention center
item.description: Rep. Kelly Morrison toured the facility twice this week. The Department of Homeland Security has defended its detention standards.

item.title: Report reveals widespread billing issues in Minnesota autism program
item.description: The Minnesota Department of Human Services hired Optum to look into 14 Medicaid-funded programs identified as vulnerable to fraud.
